brief.retrievalTarget: Less chloride is reabsorbed in the sweat duct.
brief.context: CFTR dysfunction impairs chloride reabsorption in the sweat duct, leaving sweat with excess salt/chloride.
brief.visualRelationship: Cystic fibrosis: impaired sweat-duct chloride reabsorption
brief.medium: code-native SVG with PNG raster export

factBasis.fact: People with CF do not reabsorb salt well from sweat ducts.
Sweat chloride is measured by quantitative pilocarpine iontophoresis.

brief.wrongReadingToPrevent: Do not infer unsupported quantitative proportions or a different physiology from the abstract arrows.
